ui.chat.ask_panel.answer.attachment_refu.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_panel.answer.attachment_refu.role: inline message under an ask's answer box when the user pastes or drops a file into it
ui.chat.ask_panel.answer.attachment_refu.tone: what happened, what it means, what to do; ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_panel.answer.limit_notice.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.

placeholders.max: the maximum number of characters in one answer; formatted with the locale's digit grouping

ui.chat.ask_panel.answer.limit_notice.role: inline message under an ask's answer box when the answer reached the maximum length
ui.chat.ask_panel.answer.limit_notice.tone: one full sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.asking.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.asking.role: eyebrow of the question dock while a question waits for the user
ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.asking.tone: short status, sentence case, no trailing period

ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.keys_one.note: Names the number key to press to choose option 1. Hidden from screen readers.
ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.keys_one.role: right-aligned keyboard hint on the question dock when there is one option

ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.keys_range.note: Names the number keys (1 up to {max}) that choose an option. Hidden from screen readers.

placeholders.max: the highest option number, at most 9

ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.keys_range.role: right-aligned keyboard hint on the question dock when there are several options

ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.sending.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_panel.dock.sending.role: eyebrow of the question dock while the user's answer is being sent

ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.details_missing.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.details_missing.role: empty-state line in the asks panel when the open-ask count is known but the rows did not arrive
ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.details_missing.tone: one full sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_outstanding.note: An ask is a question the AI agent put to the user and is waiting on.
ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_outstanding.role: empty-state line in the asks panel when nothing is waiting on the user
ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_outstanding.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_pending.note: 'Settled' names the sibling filter chip; use the same word you chose for ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.settled.
ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_pending.role: empty-state line shown under the Pending filter when every ask has settled
ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_pending.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_settled.note: 'pending' names the sibling filter chip; use the same word you chose for ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.pending.
ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_settled.role: empty-state line shown under the Settled filter when every ask is still waiting
ui.chat.ask_panel.empty.none_settled.tone: two short sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.all.note: Followed by a middle dot and the number of asks in that group.
ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.all.role: filter chip in the asks panel showing every ask

ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.chip.note: Keep the middle dot and the order.

placeholders.label: the already-localized group name (All, Pending or Settled)
placeholders.count: how many asks are in the group

ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.chip.role: filter chip text joining the group name and how many asks it holds

ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.pending.note: The opposite of Settled. Followed by a middle dot and a count.
ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.pending.role: filter chip in the asks panel showing asks still waiting for an answer

ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.settled.note: The opposite of Pending. Followed by a middle dot and a count.
ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.settled.role: filter chip in the asks panel showing asks already answered, dismissed or timed out

ui.chat.ask_panel.landing.many.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.

placeholders.count: how many questions timed out; renders as #

ui.chat.ask_panel.landing.many.role: live-region note when several pending questions moved to Settled after timing out
ui.chat.ask_panel.landing.many.tone: short status, sentence case, no trailing period

ui.chat.ask_panel.landing.one.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_panel.landing.one.role: live-region note when one pending question moved to Settled after timing out
ui.chat.ask_panel.landing.one.tone: short status, sentence case, no trailing period

ui.chat.ask_panel.lapse.many.note: Count is at least 2 in practice but the singular branch must still be grammatical.

placeholders.count: how many questions timed out in this lapse; renders as #

ui.chat.ask_panel.lapse.many.role: live-region note after several pending questions timed out while the user had typed answers
ui.chat.ask_panel.lapse.many.tone: one full sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_panel.lapse.one.note: Read to screen-reader users; says the typed answer was lost.
ui.chat.ask_panel.lapse.one.role: live-region note after one pending question timed out while the user had typed an answer
ui.chat.ask_panel.lapse.one.tone: one full sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.ask_panel.no_question_text.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.ask_panel.no_question_text.role: fallback title of an ask row whose question text is empty
ui.chat.ask_panel.no_question_text.tone: short noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing period

ui.chat.ask_panel.other_prompt.note: One phrase used in three places on purpose (the row hint, the field placeholder, a question with no options); keep a single translation.
ui.chat.ask_panel.other_prompt.role: hint on the Other row of an ask, and the placeholder of the free-text answer field
ui.chat.ask_panel.other_prompt.tone: short imperative, sentence case, no trailing period
